summary: arista.eos requires ansible-core 2.14+, removes previously deprecated modules and attributes, and uses netcommon 6.1.0 for cli_restore support.
questions: Which ansible-core version does arista.eos require?
Were deprecated modules removed from arista.eos?

answer_card.title: arista.eos changes in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md: arista.eos requires ansible-core 2.14+, removes previously deprecated modules and attributes (see Removed Features), and is based on netcommon 6.1.0 for the `cli_restore` plugin.
